selection_rationale: Nine of twelve mechanisms are killed, a 100% kill ratio among non-survivors. M786R-04 retains complete arithmetic failure clusters rather than local dependency bounds; an independently audited top-band star additionally kills raw symmetric max-degree LLL, and a core-with-private-satellites family kills per-packed-circuit internal representatives, but neither kills cross-cluster alteration. M786R-08 retains the full cofactor residue in a global owner-flow problem rather than bounded fan or depth; M786R-12 retains a multiscale global potential plus a revision reserve for coherent density. RR.1 rules out bounded support, forest safety, bounded-radius witnesses, bounded peel depth, cycle-rank potential, and token-count descent. RR.2 rules out bounded residue complexity, coprime splitting, and no-reserve prefix stabilization. The survivors remain distinct in probability/alteration, deterministic ownership, and recursive/coherent mechanism.
